route.title: Run the test suite and watch it pass
route.whyChosen: These are the three documented commands (dev install from docs/contributing.rst, then the parallel and serial pytest runs from the CI workflow); the install is done from the checkout with `pip install -e . --group dev` as documented, and no uv prefix was involved.

Install datasette with the dev dependency group

trapsToWarn: Upgrade pip before the install: `--group` needs pip 25.1 or newer, and an older pip (25.0.1 here) fails with "no such option: --group", so run `pip install pip==25.3` first.
